data.title: Property management: schedule meter reading and smoke detector maintenance
data.summary: Hausverwaltung Muster & Partner informs the tenant that the owners' association will have heating cost allocators read and smoke detectors serviced in January 2026, proposing 12, 14, or 16 January (8–12h), and asks for confirmation of which date works within 7 working days of the letter date.
data.explanation: Your property management company needs access to your apartment in January 2026 for a routine heating meter reading and smoke detector check. They propose three possible dates (12, 14, or 16 January, each morning between 8 and 12) and ask you to tell them which one works for you. You should reply within the deadline shown by the app, giving your preferred date so access can be arranged. No consequence is stated if you miss the window, but replying promptly avoids rescheduling hassle.
